hints.title: Look at the last move
hints.body: The final move is either one step or two steps.

hints.title: Two smaller states
hints.body: Ways to reach `n` equal ways to reach `n - 1` plus ways to reach `n - 2`.

hints.title: Base cases
hints.body: One step has one way; two steps have two ways.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
if steps <= 2: return steps
previous = 1
current = 2
for step from 3 to steps:
    previous, current = current, previous + current
return current
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
